NDI.Title: NelTempo
NDI.Lifecycle.ManualReviewRequired: Manual Review Required — resolve lifecycle recovery before advancing.
NDI.Lifecycle.TransitionBusy: A phase transition is already in progress.
NDI.Lifecycle.UnfinishedTurns: {count} combatant(s) have not ended their turn.
NDI.Lifecycle.NotOpen: The phase is not open for turn actions.
NDI.Lifecycle.CannotEndTurn: That combatant cannot end their turn right now.
NDI.Lifecycle.StartFailed: Phase start processing failed. Use recovery controls.
NDI.Lifecycle.EndFailed: Phase end processing failed. Use recovery controls.
NDI.Lifecycle.NoFailedStart: There is no failed start boundary to recover.
NDI.Lifecycle.NoFailedEnd: There is no failed end boundary to recover.
NDI.Lifecycle.PhaseCompletePrompt: The {phase} phase is complete. Advance to the next phase?
NDI.Lifecycle.ForceAdvanceConfirm: Force advance with {count} unfinished combatant(s)? Unfinished turns will be marked skipped, then end-of-phase processing runs.
NDI.Lifecycle.EndRemainingConfirm: Mark all remaining combatants as finished (skipped) without running end-of-turn processing yet?
NDI.Undo.PhaseEndWarning: This undo restores NelTempo phase state only. Native PF2e end-of-turn results (persistent damage, conditions, effects, chat, and third-party hooks) are not automatically reversed.
NDI.Setting.AutoAdvancePhase.Name: Advance Completed Phases Automatically
NDI.Setting.AutoAdvancePhase.Hint: When every combatant in the phase has ended their turn: Off waits for the GM, Prompt asks the authoritative GM once, Automatic advances through the formal phase-end boundary.
NDI.Setting.EnforceConditionTiming.Name: Enforce Condition Timing
NDI.Setting.EnforceConditionTiming.Hint: When On, Grabbed and Restrained block voluntary Delay, and Confused combatants must resolve before others in the same phase. When Off, lifecycle and End Turn remain fully functional without timing restrictions.
NDI.Notify.SelectTokens: Select the tokens that belong in the encounter, then start NelTempo again.
NDI.Notify.AlreadyActive: NelTempo is already active for this encounter.
NDI.Notify.PromptOnlyInitiative: Initiative can only be prompted during the Initiative phase.
NDI.Notify.ChecksComplete: All NelTempo checks are complete. The GM can begin Vanguard.
NDI.Error.UserInactive: The requesting user is not active.
NDI.Error.PromptInactive: That initiative prompt is no longer active.
NDI.Error.NotOwner: You do not own that combatant.
NDI.Error.DcNumber: Enemy Initiative DC must be a number.
NDI.Error.NotEligible: That combatant is not eligible in the current phase.
NDI.Error.AlreadyActed: That combatant has already acted this phase.
NDI.Error.OtherActive: Another combatant is currently taking a turn.
NDI.Error.GmOnlyEnemies: Only the GM can activate enemies.
NDI.Error.DelayOnlyVanguard: Only Vanguard combatants can delay to Rearguard.
NDI.Error.GmOnly: Only the GM can perform that action.
NDI.Timing.DelayBlocked: Delay is blocked by a condition.
NDI.Timing.AllowDelayOnceGranted: Allow Delay Once granted for this phase.
NDI.Timing.ResumeGranted: Resume Current Actor Once granted for this phase.
NDI.Timing.OverrideNeedsConfirm: Confirm the timing override before continuing.
NDI.Timing.ConfusedReopenRejected: Players cannot reopen a resolved Confused turn.
NDI.Timing.UseReopenConfusedControl: Use Reopen Confused Turn to reopen this combatant.
NDI.Timing.AdapterWarning: NelTempo could not read a PF2e condition safely; timing failed open for that combatant.
NDI.Timing.AllowDelayConfirm: Allow this combatant to Delay once despite Grabbed, Restrained, or Confused? The condition is not removed.
NDI.Timing.ResolvePriorityConfirm: Mark this Confused combatant as timing-resolved without End Turn processing? The Confused condition is not removed.
NDI.Timing.SkipPriorityConfirm: Skip the Confused priority requirement for this combatant this phase? Their turn remains open unless separately ended.
NDI.Timing.ReopenConfusedConfirm: Reopen this Confused turn? Actor state and actions are not reversed. Confused priority may be reactivated.
